howThisWorks.heading: [How this works]
howThisWorks.body1: [Poké Memory uses <link>FSRS</link>, a spaced-repetition scheduler that picks the best time to show each card based on how well you remember it.]
howThisWorks.body2: [After every grade the scheduler updates its model of how strong your memory of that card is, and sets the next review for when you're most likely to be about to forget it. Forgetting and then re-remembering is what actually moves a card into long-term memory, so getting a few Agains is normal and part of the system working.]
howThisWorks.body3: [Honest grading matters more than getting every card right. If you almost forgot, press Hard. If you truly forgot, press Again. The scheduler can't help you if you mark cards Easy when you only just scraped it.]
howThisWorks.showOnboardingAgainDescription: [Re-opens the welcome guide on the Practice page and restores contextual hints on Stats and Settings.]
